observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: A minimalist studio with plain white walls and a white floor, resembling a performance or art video backdrop.
observation.dancers: A group of multiple dancers, appearing mixed or indeterminate due to full-body costumes.
observation.formation_and_space: Dancers start in static standing lines and individual positions across the space, later scattering, moving across the floor in groups, and re-forming lines or paired poses.
observation.posture: Upright standing postures alternating with deeply bent torsos, arched backs, and inverted or handstand positions.
observation.footwork: Cannot be seen in detail due to full-body costumes, but steps involve walking, running, skipping, and turning across the floor.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms held rigidly overhead, extended to the sides, or dropped by the sides; sometimes bent at the elbows with hands framing the head or body.
observation.hips_and_torso: Strong torso arching, bending forward and backward, and undulating isolations.
observation.partnering: Independent solo movement mostly, with occasional overlapping group choreography and supporting poses such as one dancer holding another in an inversion.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Features floor-level handstands, backbends, cartwheels, and standing turns.
observation.costume_and_props: Tight-fitting full-body black or dark bodysuits with matching hats or headwear, creating silhouetted shapes against light backgrounds.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact footwork and subtle weight transfers are obscured by the dark, form-fitting costumes against varied lighting and video edits.

signature_moments.what: Three dancers stand in a line, with the outer two in upside-down handstand poses and the center dancer upright holding arms overhead.
Dancers in a line perform deep backward arching bends of their torsos while keeping legs extended.
Dancers scatter across the floor from static standing poses into dynamic running and turning movements.
